name: chronos
description: Local Codex project teams with persistent agents, Hybrid conversations, guided workflows, verified file checkpoints, review-driven correction, recovery and Windows diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Describe your goal and select framework files or a folder. Your setup chat prepares a paused Control Room workflow with model and thinking-level choices, native checks and human gates. Talk to project-scoped agents, keep decisions with their evidence, and resume compatible conversations. Hybrid defaults keep related discussion in primary chats while isolating writes, independent reviews and unrelated work. Use Structured pipelines or bounded Collaborative feedback; corrections preserve independent accepted work. Verified file checkpoints retain revisions and write rework uses fresh isolated directories. Session limits, supported compaction, recorded rotation and native archival bound growth without silently deleting history. Restart revokes consent; uncertain work requires reconciliation. Optional learning proposes changes from completed workflows without applying them. Requires local Codex and Node 22+; Windows diagnostics and existing-chat Governor are separate opt-ins. No publisher telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Set up Control Room from my goal and framework. Suggest models and thinking. Explain privacy and permissions; open paused.
Review my completed workflow with outcome learning and tool-call analysis; propose improvements without applying them.
Run a Control Room health check; optionally include Windows diagnostics with my consent.
